verdict: Lead volume doubled this week; cost per lead hit a new low.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 101 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $12.89, with the sharpest movement happening in the most recent week — leads doubled week-over-week while cost per lead dropped nearly 50%, all on essentially flat daily spend. That efficiency gain is being driven by stronger delivery on your primary Meta campaign and is holding through the last few days of the window. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile generated 136 actions this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — though activity dipped in the final two days, which we are watching closely. A number of planned buildouts, including search campaigns, landing pages, and lead nurture sequences, are overdue and remain the clearest barrier to scaling what is now a proven paid channel; work to close those gaps is the active priority heading into next period.
